card.name: Words just before a change amount
card.fires_on: Small words right before a comparison or change is stated, such as effect, increase, a, significantly or % in drug-interaction and study results. It marks the spot where the size or direction of a change is about to be given.

modes.label: Change nouns
modes.description: Nouns like effect, effects or increase that name a change, before the amount or comparison.
modes.example: can expect an incremental<< effect>> from candesartan cilex

modes.label: Small words before a quantity
modes.description: Articles, adverbs or percent signs just before the size of a difference.
modes.example: Diltiazem plasma levels were not<< significantly>> affected by lovastatin or prav

modes.label: Study comparison verbs
modes.description: Verbs that introduce the result of a before and after comparison.
modes.example: A comparison of liver biopsy findings before and after therapy<< revealed>> 49 (58%) subjects

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from words meaning original, toward words that finish a comparison.
card.plain: It lights up on the word just before a study says how much something changed.
